ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for UIUC undergraduate students. Others interested in this course may enroll in ENG 398 SW2. Academic Outreach assessments of $753 per credit hour apply. After the course begins, the College of Engineering will apply a $650 credit to UIUC undergraduate students' accounts. This course is restricted to students who have a career-related internship or co-op during the Summer 2007 term. If you do not meet this requirement you will be disqualified from the course and will not be eligible for a full refund if you do not cancel your registration by June 1, 2007. Please contact Sarah Zehr at 217-333-1960 with questions about this policy.
